_doc: Registry of benchmark configurations. Results from different configurations are never averaged together. Each result file names exactly one configuration.

CLOUD-HL-1T.note: Phase 3: 1 thread per InferenceSession and per chunk Worker.
CLOUD-HL-1T.phase7Note: Phase 7: unthrottled server on fixed port 8790 (F-36), one browser process per run

MAC-CHROME-4T.procedureNote: Following the guide, 'Load model' was clicked before 'Run SST-2 validation', so the benchmark's own load is the SECOND load of the same file in that page. This is supported by the data: memBefore.wasmHeapBytes is already non-zero, and ORT's WASM heap only exists after a first session has been created.
